name: kamae-py
description: Kamae Python - server-side Python 3.12+ domain modeling and review with rules-based customization

interface.shortDescription: Robust Python domain design and review
interface.longDescription: Server-side Python design and review skills with rules-based customization. Override dependency preferences, conventions, and review checks via .claude/rules/, .codex/rules/, or user-level rule directories. Plugin defaults live in rules/defaults/. See rules/README.md.
defaultPrompt: Use $kamae-py to design a server-side Python domain model with Pydantic v2 unions.
Use $kamae-py-review to review this Python domain diff.
